description.value: Red Garden Cafe is a breakfast-and-lunch cafe tucked into a commercial unit on Viking Way in Richmond, operating since before a 2022 ownership transition when founders Rose and Michael retired and passed the business to new owner Mahmoud. The cafe also offers corporate catering services for events within 5 km. It serves a clientele drawn from the surrounding industrial and commercial area.

address.value: Unit 2 - 3260 Viking Way, Richmond, BC V6V 1N6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is available and confirms the business is a weekday cafe in Richmond's Viking Way commercial district. The website confirms address (Unit 2 - 3260 Viking Way, Richmond BC, V6V 1N6), email (redgardencaf@gmail.com), and phone (604-231-9303) — none of which were in OSM tags. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout) are mentioned on the website; the catering page mentions delivery/pickup logistics but does not explicitly confirm walk-in takeout. The website copyright and ownership announcement are both dated 2022, suggesting no updates since the ownership transfer to Mahmoud in November 2022, though the business does not appear closed.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone (604)-231-9303 sourced from website only — cannot cross-check against OSM.
